definitions.drive_success_rate: Share of offensive drives with positive cumulative EPA.
definitions.three_and_out_rate: Share of drives with three or fewer qualifying scrimmage plays, no first down, and no points.
definitions.scoring_opportunity: Drive that reaches the opponent 40-yard line or closer.
definitions.red_zone_trip: Drive that reaches the opponent 20-yard line or closer.
definitions.red_zone_overperformance: Points per red-zone trip minus the temporary beta baseline of 4.7. This baseline will be historically calibrated.
definitions.sack_rate_allowed: Sacks divided by qualifying pass plays/dropbacks.
definitions.stuff_rate_allowed: Rushes stopped for zero or negative yards divided by rush attempts.
definitions.tfl_rate_allowed: Qualifying offensive plays ending in a tackle for loss / negative yardage divided by all qualifying scrimmage plays.
definitions.turnover_epa_impact: Sum of offensive EPA on turnover plays; more negative means greater lost value.
definitions.epa_volatility: Population standard deviation of competitive-play EPA.
definitions.efficiency_margin: Non-garbage-time offensive EPA/play minus the opponent's offensive EPA/play.
definitions.expected_margin: Beta retrospective scoring margin derived from the complete underlying game-quality profile.
definitions.postgame_win_expectancy: Beta win probability derived from expected margin; retrospective and not a pregame forecast.
